message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In Expand.extractFile, the only guard before writing is `if (!f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith(dir.getAbsolutePath()))`, which is an inadequate containment check. It compares uncanonicalized absolute path strings using `startsWith` without requiring a separator, so attacker-controlled zip entry names such as `../evil` or paths with a sibling prefix can pass the check while `f` resolves outside `dir`; the tainted entry name then reaches the `new FileOutputStream(f)` sink."}]}
